messages:
Sam H: Quick check — can vendor confirm a temporary soft-reserve for EU-west H100 slots next Tue 2025-04-08 09:00-13:00 UTC? Partner demo needs ~8 slots. Prefer H100, but OK with A500 mix as fallback. Any hard-hold vs soft-hold ETA and billing delta?

Vendor Ops: Can tentatively hold 6 H100; 2 slots subject to availability. Need PO reference `RF-23-HOLD` to lock. Hard guarantee adds ~+18% to rate. Preemptible risk is low but not zero — we'd mark them non-preemptible if PO provided. Will confirm serials/regions by EOD.

Maria T: If we can't get hard hold, can engineering carve 4 slots from the eu-dedicated demo pool? @Lee K @Rohit P

Lee K: I can carve 4 for the time window if we compress training jobs. That will bump the billing forecast; need billing OK. I can raise a small change request.

Rohit P: Oncall note — eu-dedicated has a canary at 10:30. Carving 4 might cause that canary to shift. Suggest: (a) carve 4 + vendor hold the rest, or (b) mix in A500 for non-latency-critical parts. @Maria T please coordinate with QA for shard timings.

Sam H: Plan agreed for now: 1) Vendor Ops to confirm hold + PO code 2) Lee raise billing delta ticket 3) Maria coordinate QA shard timings to avoid the 10:30 canary. I'll block 09:00-13:00 in calendar as tentative. Ping here with serials or the PO ref.

Vendor Ops: Banking action — sample hold request (copy/paste):

```
POST https://vendor.api/reservations
{
  "po_ref": "RF-23-HOLD",
  "region": "eu-west1",
  "sku": "H100",
  "quantity": 6,
  "start": "2025-04-08T09:00:00Z",
  "end": "2025-04-08T13:00:00Z",
  "guarantee": "soft"
}
```

Vendor Ops: Will update here within 4 hours. (reaction: :eyes:)

deploy-bot: Reminder — maintenance window eu-west1 scheduled 2025-04-07 23:00-23:30 UTC (no GPU impact expected).
